SELECT ?process (SUM(?energy) AS ?energyKWh)
(SUM(?ghg) AS ?ghgKgCO2e) WHERE {
{ SELECT DISTINCT ?process ?op ?energy ?ghg WHERE {

?op a i:ProcessOperation ; i:partOfProcess ?process .

FILTER(isNumeric(?inputEnergy) && ?inputEnergy >= 0)
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?op i:consumesEnergyKWh ?rowEnergyOther .
FILTER(!isNumeric(?rowEnergyOther) || ?rowEnergyOther != ?inputEnergy) }
?op t:hasEmissionFactor ?rowFactor .
FILTER(isIRI(?rowFactor))
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?op t:hasEmissionFactor ?rowOtherFactor .

FILTER(ABS(?inputGHG - ?inputEnergy * ?rowFactorValue) <= 0.000000001)
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?lot a i:Lot ; i:hasProcess ?allProcess ; i:hasActivity ?allOperation .
?allOperation a i:ProcessOperation ; i:partOfProcess ?allProcess .
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?allOperation i:consumesEnergyKWh ?allEnergy .

FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?allOperation i:consumesEnergyKWh ?allCheckEnergyOther .

FILTER(!sameTerm(?allCheckOtherFactor,?allCheckFactor)) }
?allCheckFactor a t:ElectricityEmissionFactor ; t:factorUnit "kg CO2e/kWh" .
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?allCheckFactor t:factorUnit ?allCheckOtherUnit .

FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?allCheckFactor t:factorValue ?allCheckFactorOther .
FILTER(!isNumeric(?allCheckFactorOther) || ?allCheckFactorOther != ?allCheckFactorValue) }
?allOperation e:hasGHGImpactKgCO2e ?allGHG .
FILTER(isNumeric(?allGHG) && ?allGHG >= 0)
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?allOperation e:hasGHGImpactKgCO2e ?allCheckGHGOther .
FILTER(!isNumeric(?allCheckGHGOther) || ?allCheckGHGOther != ?allGHG) }
FILTER(ABS(?allGHG - ?allEnergy * ?allCheckFactorValue) <= 0.000000001) } }
}
GROUP BY ?lot ?process ?op } } }
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?badLot a i:Lot ; i:hasProcess ?process ; i:hasActivity ?badOp .
?badOp a i:ProcessOperation ; i:partOfProcess ?process .
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?badOp i:consumesEnergyKWh ?badEnergy .
FILTER(isNumeric(?badEnergy) && ?badEnergy >= 0)
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?badOp i:consumesEnergyKWh ?processCheckEnergyOther .
FILTER(!isNumeric(?processCheckEnergyOther) || ?processCheckEnergyOther != ?badEnergy) }
?badOp t:hasEmissionFactor ?processCheckFactor .
FILTER(isIRI(?processCheckFactor))

FILTER(!sameTerm(?processCheckOtherFactor,?processCheckFactor)) }
?processCheckFactor a t:ElectricityEmissionFactor ; t:factorUnit "kg CO2e/kWh" .
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?processCheckFactor t:factorUnit ?processCheckOtherUnit .
FILTER(STR(?processCheckOtherUnit) != "kg CO2e/kWh") }
?processCheckFactor t:factorValue ?processCheckFactorValue .
FILTER(isNumeric(?processCheckFactorValue) && ?processCheckFactorValue >= 0)
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?processCheckFactor t:factorValue ?processCheckFactorOther .
FILTER(!isNumeric(?processCheckFactorOther) || ?processCheckFactorOther != ?processCheckFactorValue) }
?badOp e:hasGHGImpactKgCO2e ?badGHG .
FILTER(isNumeric(?badGHG) && ?badGHG >= 0)
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?badOp e:hasGHGImpactKgCO2e ?processCheckGHGOther .
FILTER(!isNumeric(?processCheckGHGOther) || ?processCheckGHGOther != ?badGHG) }
FILTER(ABS(?badGHG - ?badEnergy * ?processCheckFactorValue) <= 0.000000001) } }

PREFIX i: <http://w3id.org/protys/ontology/iso15531#>
PREFIX e: <http://w3id.org/protys/ontology/iso14040#>
PREFIX c: <http://w3id.org/protys/ontology/core#>
PREFIX a: <http://w3id.org/protys/ontology/alignment#>

PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
# Q07 Residuo de balance después de pérdidas registradas, tolerancia máxima 1%
SELECT ?operation ?inputMassKg ?outputMassKg ?registeredLossKg ?residueKg ?status
WHERE { ?operation a i:ProcessOperation ; t:inputMassKg ?inputMassKg ; t:outputMassKg ?outputMassKg ; t:registeredLossKg ?registeredLossKg .
BIND(ABS(?inputMassKg - ?outputMassKg - ?registeredLossKg) AS ?residueKg)
BIND(IF(?inputMassKg <= 0 || ?outputMassKg < 0 || ?registeredLossKg < 0, "INVALID_INPUT",
IF(?residueKg <= 0.01 * ?inputMassKg, "OK", "REVISAR")) AS ?status) } ORDER BY ?operation

FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?operation i:consumesEnergyKWh ?stageEnergyOther .

?operation t:hasEmissionFactor ?stageFactor .
FILTER(isIRI(?stageFactor))
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?operation t:hasEmissionFactor ?stageOtherFactor .
FILTER(!sameTerm(?stageOtherFactor,?stageFactor)) }
?stageFactor a t:ElectricityEmissionFactor ; t:factorUnit "kg CO2e/kWh" .
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?stageFactor t:factorUnit ?stageOtherUnit .
FILTER(STR(?stageOtherUnit) != "kg CO2e/kWh") }
?stageFactor t:factorValue ?stageFactorValue .
FILTER(isNumeric(?stageFactorValue) && ?stageFactorValue >= 0)
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?stageFactor t:factorValue ?stageFactorOther .

?operation e:hasGHGImpactKgCO2e ?rawGHG .

FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?operation e:hasGHGImpactKgCO2e ?stageGHGOther .
FILTER(!isNumeric(?stageGHGOther) || ?stageGHGOther != ?rawGHG) }
FILTER(ABS(?rawGHG - ?rawEnergy * ?stageFactorValue) <= 0.000000001)
?operation t:outputVolumeL ?rawVolume .
FILTER(isNumeric(?rawVolume) && ?rawVolume > 0)
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?operation t:outputVolumeL ?stageVolumeOther .
FILTER(!isNumeric(?stageVolumeOther) || ?stageVolumeOther != ?rawVolume) }
} GROUP BY ?operation }
} ORDER BY ?operation

PREFIX a: <http://w3id.org/protys/ontology/alignment#>

# Q03 Electricidad y emisiones por lote, sin fuentes de materias primas
SELECT ?lot (SUM(?energy) AS ?energyKWh)
(SUM(?ghg) AS ?ghgKgCO2e) WHERE { { SELECT ?lot ?op (MIN(?inputEnergy) AS ?energy)
(MIN(?inputGHG) AS ?ghg) WHERE {
?lot a i:Lot ; i:hasProcess ?process ; i:hasActivity ?op .
?op a i:ProcessOperation ; i:partOfProcess ?process .

?op i:consumesEnergyKWh ?inputEnergy .
FILTER(isNumeric(?inputEnergy) && ?inputEnergy >= 0)
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?op i:consumesEnergyKWh ?rowEnergyOther .
FILTER(!isNumeric(?rowEnergyOther) || ?rowEnergyOther != ?inputEnergy) }
?op t:hasEmissionFactor ?rowFactor .
FILTER(isIRI(?rowFactor))
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?op t:hasEmissionFactor ?rowOtherFactor .
FILTER(!sameTerm(?rowOtherFactor,?rowFactor)) }
?rowFactor a t:ElectricityEmissionFactor ; t:factorUnit "kg CO2e/kWh" .
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?rowFactor t:factorUnit ?rowOtherUnit .
FILTER(STR(?rowOtherUnit) != "kg CO2e/kWh") }
?rowFactor t:factorValue ?rowFactorValue .
FILTER(isNumeric(?rowFactorValue) && ?rowFactorValue >= 0)
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?rowFactor t:factorValue ?rowFactorOther .
FILTER(!isNumeric(?rowFactorOther) || ?rowFactorOther != ?rowFactorValue) }
?op e:hasGHGImpactKgCO2e ?inputGHG .
FILTER(isNumeric(?inputGHG) && ?inputGHG >= 0)
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?op e:hasGHGImpactKgCO2e ?rowGHGOther .
FILTER(!isNumeric(?rowGHGOther) || ?rowGHGOther != ?inputGHG) }
FILTER(ABS(?inputGHG - ?inputEnergy * ?rowFactorValue) <= 0.000000001)
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?lot a i:Lot ; i:hasProcess ?allProcess ; i:hasActivity ?allOperation .
?allOperation a i:ProcessOperation ; i:partOfProcess ?allProcess .
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?allOperation i:consumesEnergyKWh ?allEnergy .
FILTER(isNumeric(?allEnergy) && ?allEnergy >= 0)
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?allOperation i:consumesEnergyKWh ?allCheckEnergyOther .
FILTER(!isNumeric(?allCheckEnergyOther) || ?allCheckEnergyOther != ?allEnergy) }
?allOperation t:hasEmissionFactor ?allCheckFactor .
FILTER(isIRI(?allCheckFactor))
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?allOperation t:hasEmissionFactor ?allCheckOtherFactor .
FILTER(!sameTerm(?allCheckOtherFactor,?allCheckFactor)) }
?allCheckFactor a t:ElectricityEmissionFactor ; t:factorUnit "kg CO2e/kWh" .
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?allCheckFactor t:factorUnit ?allCheckOtherUnit .
FILTER(STR(?allCheckOtherUnit) != "kg CO2e/kWh") }
?allCheckFactor t:factorValue ?allCheckFactorValue .
FILTER(isNumeric(?allCheckFactorValue) && ?allCheckFactorValue >= 0)
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?allCheckFactor t:factorValue ?allCheckFactorOther .
FILTER(!isNumeric(?allCheckFactorOther) || ?allCheckFactorOther != ?allCheckFactorValue) }
?allOperation e:hasGHGImpactKgCO2e ?allGHG .
FILTER(isNumeric(?allGHG) && ?allGHG >= 0)
FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?allOperation e:hasGHGImpactKgCO2e ?allCheckGHGOther .
FILTER(!isNumeric(?allCheckGHGOther) || ?allCheckGHGOther != ?allGHG) }
FILTER(ABS(?allGHG - ?allEnergy * ?allCheckFactorValue) <= 0.000000001) } }
}
GROUP BY ?lot ?op }
} GROUP BY ?lot ORDER BY ?lot
